system.description:
You know how to pound targets when firing heavy-weapons emplacements and vehicle weaponry.

Prerequisite: Weapon Focus (Heavy Weapons)

Effect: When making an attack roll using a Weapon Emplacement or a Weapon System, you add an additional 1 point of damage for every 5 points you roll above the target's Reflex Defense. If you exceed the target's Damage Threshold, then on its next turn the target cannot attack and its speed is reduced by 2 squares (1 square Starship Scale).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
